notify.prompt: Get a heads-up when the aurora is likely overhead.
notify.ctaDetail: Instant push the moment the lights are likely overhead.
notify.description: At most one alert per dark night, never 02:00–06:00.
notify.explain: Your browser will now ask for permission. You'll get at most one alert per dark night when the lights are likely — never 02:00–06:00. Unsubscribe anytime here.
notify.unsupported: Your browser does not support notifications
notify.ios: To get alerts on iPhone/iPad, add this app to your Home Screen: tap the Share button, choose ‘Add to Home Screen’, then open it from there.
notify.blockedHint: Notifications are blocked for this site. Open Site settings → Notifications → Allow, then reload the page.
notify.dismissedHint: Your browser didn’t complete the request — Microsoft Edge and Chrome sometimes hold notification prompts quietly. Look for a bell icon in the address bar, or open Site settings → Notifications → Allow, then try again.
notify.subscribedDetail: We'll alert you about aurora near {{place}}. Unsubscribe below anytime.
notify.subscribedCadence: At most one alert per dark night, never 02:00–06:00.

consent.title: Privacy
consent.message: We use anonymous, cookie-free analytics to improve the app. You can opt out any time.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This app is built to collect as little data about you as possible.
privacy.whatWeUseBody: Your location (only in your browser, to fetch the forecast), chosen language and consent are stored locally. If you enable aurora alerts, we store your push subscription and a coarse location to send the alert.
privacy.whatWeDontBody: No ads, no tracking cookies, no sharing with third parties. Analytics are anonymous and cookie-free.
privacy.retentionBody: You can turn off alerts at any time, which deletes your subscription.
